text: sufr list prints every suffix in full on every row, so its output grows with the square of the text: 1.9 GB for the 98 KB uniprot fixture, and a 10 MiB build does not finish in minutes. To compare two builds of a large input, cmp -l the .sufr files and map the differing offsets onto the regions in the layout comment in libsufr/src/format.rs; summarize gives num_suffixes. Seen 2026-11-03.
